subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FOREST’ is written as ‘GUSITU’, and ‘MANGROVE’ is written as ‘NEOHSUWI’. How will ‘REINCARNATE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3569505ffb21c583847ffcc66460cd420cd2ed05a859d6d6f776d5dd10952678.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Consonants are added +1 in alphabet order.**

**Vowels are added +1 in vowel alphabet order and the next vowel is obtained.**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6dd4cb946beb6286291b178bb3cf7079a428a050b9b3c758140ed7c01cc9173.png] 
 
• **This means A →** +1** → E **+1 → I +1 → O +1 → U

‘FOREST’ is written as ‘GUSITU’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/098354e8e8bda7da620981ed19fb6257f1925f7073151823b3a4c111dd29ddc3.png] 

and

‘MANGROVE’ is written as ‘NEOHSUWI’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2cc796eebf64b13e8621ed3fd66b5a2d4a93d533a3540f413c9324f17401f91.png] 

Similarly,

‘REINCARNATE’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35307eaa0086c1412f194628a5ba7b1e377cc1245c615a3e688fecc6de684252.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SIOODESOEUI".**
